EMPLOYEES.LABEL: Employee Report
EMPLOYEES.DESC: Full employee roster with department, designation, hire date, nationality and salary details.

PAYROLL.LABEL: Payroll Report
PAYROLL.DESC: Monthly salary register with breakdown of basic, allowances, GOSI and net pay.

LEAVE_BALANCE.LABEL: Leave Balance Report
LEAVE_BALANCE.DESC: Annual Leave balance per employee — entitlement, days used, pending and remaining.

LEAVE_REQUESTS.LABEL: Leave Requests Report
LEAVE_REQUESTS.DESC: All leave requests in the selected period, filterable by status, type and department.

ATTENDANCE.LABEL: Attendance Report
ATTENDANCE.DESC: Daily attendance log for the selected month or date range - check-in/out times, hours worked and status.

LOANS.LABEL: Loan Report
LOANS.DESC: Active and historical employee loans — principal, outstanding balance and repayment progress.
